pageDescription: Convert iPhone HEIC and HEIF photos to JPG or PNG with this free online HEIC to JPG converter. Drop one photo or a whole batch, pick JPG or PNG, set the quality, and download — typically in under a second. Everything runs locally in your browser, so your photos are never uploaded and stay completely private. Perfect for opening HEIC files on Windows, sharing iPhone photos that won't display elsewhere, or attaching images to forms that reject HEIC. No signup, no watermarks, no file limits.

instructions.title: How to convert HEIC to JPG

steps.title: Add your HEIC photos
steps.description: Drag and drop one or more .heic / .heif files onto the upload area, or click to browse. You can convert many photos at once.

steps.title: Choose JPG or PNG
steps.description: Pick JPG for the smallest, most compatible files, or PNG if you need lossless output with transparency support.

steps.title: Set the quality (JPG)
steps.description: Drag the quality slider for JPG output. Around 90% keeps photos sharp while staying small; lower it for tinier files.

steps.title: Convert
steps.description: Click Convert. Each photo is decoded and re-encoded right in your browser — nothing is uploaded to any server.

steps.title: Download your images
steps.description: Preview each converted photo and download it individually, or use Download all to save the whole batch at once.
